claims.text: Al-Hf-Nb-Ti-V alloys are aluminum-rich refractory high-entropy alloys that can contain an ordered B2 phase.
The target Al-rich refractory alloy has a B2 matrix containing FCC precipitates.
Aging will produce a ductile-brittle-ductile transition in the target multiphase alloy.
Initial aging promotes local chemical order in the B2 phase.
Increasing local chemical order raises antiphase-boundary energy.
Increasing local chemical order raises complex stacking-fault energy.
The local-order energy landscape traps dislocations through nanoscale segment detrapping and increases CRSS.
The aging-induced increase in local order and dislocation resistance causes the initial loss of ductility.
Prolonged aging or higher aging temperature can create a metastable, lower-order or partially disordered B2 phase.
Stress-induced martensitic transformation can occur in a B2 phase of an FCC+B2 high-entropy alloy.
B2 stress-induced martensitic transformation accommodates strain incompatibility, relieves stress concentrations, and restores ductility.
The initial alloy has moderate long-range order of approximately 33% of a reference state.
The initial alloy has a fracture strain greater than 30%.
Aging at 600–800 K for 1–100 hours is an appropriate window for substantial local-order evolution and possible phase transformation.
The relevant aging window lies below the order-disorder transformation temperature but above the temperature required for appreciable ordering kinetics.
Weak long-range order or weak dislocation-pinning barriers explain the high baseline ductility of Al15Hf25Nb32Ti28.
A VEC interval of 5.5–6.2 is a covalency-dominated valley.
The proposed non-monotonic ductility transition applies only outside the VEC interval of 5.5–6.2, particularly above 6.2 where metallic bonding permits dislocation mobility.
The B2 phase must be sufficiently small to avoid coarse-precipitate cracking.
The NiCoCr local-order simulations omitted spin polarization, so their applicability to magnetic effects in the proposed Al-rich alloys is uncertain.
